Open PR binds topic tree, clean branch, unchanged remote main, absent matching PR, explicit push ref and exact title/body readback.
Comment review is explicitly COMMENT and exact head; coordinator must preserve reviewed draft text and hosted-peer evidence. No approval or automatic review reset.

Enqueue requires exact-head passing peer, validate-strict, live SQUASH/ALLGREEN queue, posted exact-head COMMENT, preflight command/log evidence and live-main base; read-before-enqueue race disclosed.
Cleanup requires actual merge, exact tree/parent, configured live issue dispositions, clean owned topic; remote deletion uses exact ref lease and local deletion follows detached verified merge.
Isolated preflight/postmerge creates new temporary clones only, checks preserved tag, absence of topic object, exact tree/base and actual record/history/review/coverage gates.

Original-main synchronization verifies actual postmerge/hosted/cleanup identities, hidden/ignored byte/mode/link snapshots and path collisions, then ff-only; imported legacy library main is guarded and not executed via run_name snapshot_library.

Hosted audit verifies complete paginated PR files and each tree blob, exact title/body/comment, exact PR validation plus actual merge-group/main validation/integrity/Pages runs and all jobs; pending observations remain unique and final file is success-only.
